cand.title: Gruner AG
cand.excerpt: New office strengthens Western Switzerland presence and collaboration with clients and partners; part of national/international network.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Samuel Collin, Head of Buildings Western Switzerland, is quoted about the Geneva opening and is a relevant regional relationship sponsor. Emmanuel Everbecq, Regional Director from 2026-01-01 with administrative responsibility for four Western Switzerland Infrastructure business units, is a second relevant regional sponsor. Neither is verified as a hotel buyer or contract signatory. Monika Garcia is explicitly named for administration of a Zurich training course; she is a possible training-process referral, not a verified Geneva lodging buyer.
findings.futureEdition: None found officially announced for this Geneva-expansion lead within 2026-12-07–2028-06-30. The verified activity is an office operational since 2026-01-01, not a conference or inauguration programme. That date is stated as the operational start, not merely inferred from the article date. No next edition, dates, city or venue can be assigned.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel specification: conditional fit for regional cross-office workshops, training, small residential meetings or visiting project teams if the buyer accepts Founex and airport-corridor access. First test day-meeting/F&B demand; overnight demand is unproven. The Geneva office is city-centre based and lists nine employees, so local office growth alone does not justify a 20–120-room block. The supplied 237-room hotel and approximately 250-theatre maximum are capacity ceilings, not demand estimates. No evidence supports whole-house use, a resort requirement, Palexpo overflow or a Lausanne-to-Founex booking pattern.
findings.venueCommitments: No event venue commitment established for the target lead. The exact known corporate address is Gruner SA, Boulevard James Fazy 8, CH-1201 Geneva, Canton of Geneva, Switzerland: Geneva city, outside the Founex/Nyon/La Côte/Geneva Airport corridor. This is an office, not a confirmed event venue or host hotel. Future event venue, city and region are unknown.
findings.historicalRotation: No edition timeline or destination rotation established for the Geneva-office lead. Separately, Gruner published Trends im Brandschutz on 2026-11-03 at Leonardo, Thurgauerstrasse 80, 8050 Zurich, Canton of Zurich, Switzerland; and Brandfallsteuerungen richtig planen on 2026-11-26 at the same address. The first is past as of 2026-11-16; the second is upcoming but before the requested horizon. These are distinct training courses, not successive Geneva editions or evidence of annual recurrence.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Unknown for the target lead. No edition-specific housing bureau, host hotel, hotel list, room block, room-night allocation or open RFP was identified. The office announcement says the site is “operational since January 1, 2026”; it provides no lodging pathway. The separate training listing states “Ort: Leonardo, Thurgauerstrasse 80, 8050 Zürich”, but does not establish a hotel booking or accommodation block. No incumbent lodging hotels can be named from the reviewed sources; sourcing must not be labelled open.
findings.organizationStructure: Corporate engineering and planning business, not an association, PCO or DMC. The Geneva office is published as Gruner SA within the Gruner network. Its location page lists nine employees; this is office headcount, not event attendance or room demand. The Infrastructure regional reorganisation into four business units took effect on 2026-01-01. Buildings and Infrastructure leadership should not be conflated.
findings.competitiveLimitations: No sourced incumbent lodging contract or overflow evidence identified. The verified Geneva location is city-centre; inference: Founex needs a specific transfer, airport-access or residential-meeting rationale rather than an assumption that it substitutes for downtown accommodation. Published Zurich courses have a specified site outside the hotel territory; they are not immediately capturable Founex events. No evidence establishes that lodging is committed elsewhere, either.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Approach Samuel Collin through the published Geneva office channel, Geneve@gruner.ch, and seek an introduction to the person arranging regional meetings and travel. Develop a parallel Infrastructure relationship with Emmanuel Everbecq. Ask about December 2026–June 2028 offsites, visiting project teams and client workshops; obtain dates, participant origins, overnight need, transfer requirements, budget and procurement route before quoting. Offer a site visit and a conditional day-meeting/residential proposal within the supplied hotel limits, not an assumed room block. If pursuing training formats, ask Monika Garcia how sites are selected; her published remit concerns the Zurich course only.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: There is no verified current event edition for the Geneva-expansion lead to sell against. The office has operated since 2026-01-01. The separate 2026-11-26 Zurich course has a stated venue and lies before the requested horizon; it is not a current YOTEL Geneva Lake opportunity. Public-source absence does not demonstrate that an unadvertised internal event is available.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: retain as a regional corporate relationship prospect, not confirmed upcoming event business or verified recurring competitive capture. Gruner publishes training activity and cross-location networking, which supplies a conversation rationale only. Its reported digital Meet & Lunch had more than 100 participants in February 2026; virtual participation must not be converted into physical attendance, guestrooms or a proposed room block. No future Geneva edition or rotation is established.
